additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390208-DC/Si-D/FR-[am8txK] charging session with a credit card was not able to stop CRM:01811000453
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to give an update why the charging session could not be stopped using your credit card.
The session was actually started through a
RemoteStart
transaction, not by the credit card. As a result, the session can only be stopped using the
RemoteStop
feature or directly from the EV side.
If a charging session is started using the credit card, then it can be stopped using the same credit card.
However, since the session began through the RemoteStart process, it can only be stopped from the RemoteStop or EV side,not via the credit card.
I hope this clarifies the situation. Can we proceed with case closure?
If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please don’t hesitate to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390208-DC/Si-D/FR-[am8txK] charging session with a credit card was not able to stop CRM:01811000453
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien,
I hope this email finds you well.
I am reaching out regarding an issue with a credit card charging session that could not be stopped.
Upon checking the logs, I was unable to find any specific information, except for the following error:
"Could not convert receipt number to TA number."
The potential reason for this error appears to be that the
Reconciliation (End of Day)
process was triggered before the
Partial Reversal
could be completed. As a result, the transaction was already finished and reversed by the payment host, which made it unsolvable at this point.
I trust this provides clarity on the matter.
Please let me know if further action is required from our end.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita Khobare
